_comment: Atlas classifications, glossary and Ranger tag masking for the rsingh_mcc_* databases, applied by scripts/governance.py. Only MCC_* classifications and rsingh-mcc-* policies are created or changed; other projects' tags and policies are left alone.

MCC_SENSITIVE_HASH.description: Person name, email or bureau reference: masked users see a hash, so joins and counts per customer still work

MCC_SENSITIVE_CONTACT.description: Mobile number: masked users see only the last 4 digits

MCC_SENSITIVE_DOB.description: Date of birth: masked users see only the year (driver_age stays usable)

MCC_SENSITIVE_VEHICLE_ID.description: VIN or registration number: masked users see a hash, so VIN-mismatch and crash matching still compare

MCC_SENSITIVE_FINANCIAL.description: Credit bureau score or band: masked users see NULL

masking._comment: federal07 and rsingh are in no masking policy and see clear values

glossary.name: MCC Claims KPIs
glossary.description: Certified motor-claims KPIs of the Motor Claim Copilot lakehouse. Each term is defined once (config/kpi.json) and assigned to its certified semantic view and the MIS view that reads it.
